free_tier.stated: Lovable Free: "Daily build credits 5/day, 30/month", "Monthly Cloud grant 20 credits", "Monthly AI grant 4 credits", quoted; the footnote says "on Free, you receive daily build credits for the first 6 days each month (6 x 5 = 30), then none until the next month starts"

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: the 20-credit monthly Cloud grant hosts a small app and its backend after the 30 monthly build credits are gone; on Free, code cannot be edited or downloaded inside Lovable, but Git sync with GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket is included, so the code moves through a repository

limits.value: the 30-credit monthly cap exhausts on the sixth day of the month, so two thirds of every month has zero build capacity on the free plan.
